results.title: The beacon of hope: Coach Opeele touts Andre Ayew as the man to rescue Ghana football
results.content: A growing call for change at the top of Ghana football is gaining momentum, with former Black Stars captain Andre “Dede” Ayew emerging as the people’s favourite to lead the Ghana Football Association (GFA) into a new era. results.title: Agyinasare demands full disclosure of National Cathedral money
results.content: Archbishop Charles Agyinasare has challenged those behind the National Cathedral project to open their financial records to public scrutiny, insisting that churches must know how contributions have been handled before being asked to help complete the controversial facility.

results.title: Retaining the incumbent regional chairman is the surest bet for Ashanti NDC
results.content: Mohammed Yakubu, the Member of Parliament (MP) for Ahafo Ano South-East, has described the re-election of Mr Andrews Nana Akwasi as Ashanti Regional Chairman of the NDC as the surest bet for maximising the party’s votes in the Election 2028.

results.title: Oti Regional Minister highlights government development projects
results.content: The government has set a target to process 100 per cent of Ghana’s cocoa locally by 2030 as part of efforts to deepen value addition, expand agro-processing and retain more economic benefits from the cocoa industry.

results.title: Ghana exports to China surge under zero-tariff policy
results.content: Ghana’s exports to China rose sharply following the implementation of China’s zero-tariff policy, with imports from Ghana reaching US$290 million in June 2026.

results.title: BoG warns strong El Niño could affect food prices, cocoa and cedi
results.content: Dr Johnson Pandit Asiama, Governor of the Bank of Ghana (BoG), Monday warned that an unusually strong El Niño episode could affect agricultural production across West Africa, including Ghana.

results.title: Opoku-Agyemang rallies collective responsibility for quality education
results.content: Vice President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has called for sustained collaboration between government and stakeholders to make quality education a shared national responsibility.

results.title: Ghana now Africa’s eighth-largest economy, second in West Africa – Mahama tells Investment Summit
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has hailed Ghana’s economic recovery, declaring the country as “one of Africa’s most resilient and promising economies” as he opened the Ghana Investment Summit 2026 in Accra.

results.title: Governor Asiama urges vigilance as MPC holds final 2026 meeting
results.content: Dr Johnson Pandit Asiama, Governor of the Bank of Ghana (BoG), has cautioned against complacency as the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) holds its final meeting for 2026.

results.title: Farmers urged to engage in climate-smart agriculture practices for improved yields
results.content: Cecilia Adoma Yeboah Junior, the Sunyani Municipal Director of Agriculture, has advised farmers to engage in climate-smart agricultural practices for improved crop yields.

results.title: Robert Pattinson to replace Daniel Craig as James Bond
results.content: Robert Pattinson, the British actor known for films such as Twilight and The Batman, has been confirmed as the next actor to play James Bond.

results.title: Experience alone is no longer enough to run banks; use data and research – First Deputy Governor
results.content: The First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Ghana, Dr Zakari Mumuni, urged banking sector managers to base decisions on data and research, warning that experience alone is no longer enough to navigate the industry’s growing complexity.

results.title: 2027 interest bill exceeds allocations to four job-creating ministries, says Amin Adam
results.content: Former Finance Minister Dr Mohammed Amin Adam says Ghana’s projected GH¢61 billion interest bill for 2027 exceeds the combined allocations to four ministries he identified as key to job creation.

results.title: ‘Economic recovery did not start with NDC’ – Amin Adam
results.content: Former Finance Minister Dr Mohammed Amin Adam has accused the government of taking undue credit for Ghana’s economic recovery, insisting that key improvements in the economy were already underway before the NDC administration assumed office.

results.title: ACFE Ghana launches Fraud Awareness Week amid 48% rise in reported financial fraud
results.content: The Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) Ghana Chapter has launched a week-long public education campaign to tackle rising financial and cyber-enabled fraud, following a 48 per cent increase in reported fraud cases across Ghana’s banking and payment services sectors in 2025.

results.title: Intel sued by investors after PC sales slump hits share price
results.content: Intel, the US chip giant, faces a shareholder lawsuit accusing it of hiding the severity of a slump in personal computer (PC) sales that caused its share price to plunge almost 29% in one day.

results.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
results.content: California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the ChatGPT-maker misled and endangered the public by developing artificial intelligence (AI) models without proper safeguards.

results.title: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he ‘may not return alive’
results.content: Pakistan's jailed former PM Imran Khan has appealed for urgent medical treatment, saying that his and his wife's health has been deteriorating.

results.title: Ghana’s public debt has jumped from $49bn to $65bn, says Amin Adam
results.content: Former Finance Minister Dr Mohammed Amin Adam says Ghana’s public debt has risen from $49 billion at the end of 2024 to $65 billion in October 2026.

results.title: Amin Adam accuses Finance Minister of heavy borrowing as debt rises GH¢118bn
results.content: Former Finance Minister in the Akufo-Addo administration, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam, has accused Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson of heavy borrowing.

results.title: Declare emergency in galamsey-ravaged communities – Agyinasare
results.content: Archbishop Charles Agyinasare has urged the government to impose emergency measures in communities devastated by illegal mining (galamsey), warning that some forests and rivers have suffered such extensive damage that ordinary interventions may no longer be enough.

results.title: Cameroon, Senegal and Benin close in on AFCON 2027 qualification
results.content: Nicolas Jackson was on target again as Senegal, Cameroon and Benin moved to the brink of qualification for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) with away victories.

results.title: Vinicius says transfer interest affected Real form
results.content: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr says he felt "truly overwhelmed" by transfer speculation in the summer, which has contributed to his mixed form at the start of the season.

results.title: Belgium’s Lukaku retires from internationals
results.content: Romelu Lukaku has retired from international football, saying he has "enjoyed every single moment" of playing for Belgium.

results.title: Wirtz double helps Germany thrash Netherlands
results.content: Florian Wirtz scored twice as Germany thrashed the Netherlands in their final Nations League game - with both sides qualifying for the quarter-finals.

results.title: Portugal boss responds to criticism from Ronaldo’s mum
results.content: Jorge Jesus has responded to claims by Cristiano Ronaldo's mother, Dolores Aveiro, that her son had been "deceived" by the Portugal manager.

results.title: Wontumi offers GH¢25m in fresh bid to end EXIM Bank prosecution
results.content: Former New Patriotic Party (NPP) Ashanti Regional Chairman, Bernard Antwi-Boasiako, popularly known as Chairman Wontumi, has made a fresh proposal to the Attorney-General to pay GH¢25 million towards settling the GH¢30 million financial loss at the centre of his trial involving the Ghana Export-Import (EXIM) Bank.

results.title: Customers report service outages at major US banks
results.content: Thousands of customers at major US banks, including JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America, have reported trouble accessing services.

results.title: You cannot claim restructuring gains and fault repayments – Amin Adam challenges Forson
results.content: Former Finance Minister Dr Mohammed Amin Adam has challenged Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson over his criticism of Ghana’s debt repayment schedule.

results.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
results.content: Five EU countries will open a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda next year as part of a broader push to boost removals.
